subject: english
question: How does the passage describe Black Death?

options.text: The first wave of the second plague pandemic
The worst specimen of human created tragedy
The specimen of human evolution and its evidence
The initiator of all the future pandemics

solution:
The correct answer is 'The first wave of the second plague pandemic'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• According to the given passage, it is mentioned that 'After all, the Black Death was **the first wave of the second plague pandemic** of the 14th to early 19th centuries. '
 
• So we can say that the passage describes Black Death as 'The first wave of the second plague pandemic'.
 
• Hence, 'option 1)' is the correct answer.
